Kora knows the difference between when she is working & when she isn’t. there is no excuse for barking or showing any type of aggression towards people, animals, etc while she is working. that being said, Kora has ZERO protection training. she doesn’t even have a bark task lol. this is just a great example of genetics & hard work. her genetics don’t make her any less of a service dog; they make her Kora 🐺🤎
